label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_02
text: It catches the winds that blow across Paldea and,\nslowly yet powerfully, spins ever on.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_03
text: My leaping down from that windmill to appear\nbefore those who would challenge my Gym\r\nlends an added depth to our battles![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_04
text: I knew you would understand my reasoning,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Hahahaha![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_05
text: Though I believe I can spare my legs today, as we\nare sure to create my greatest masterpiece yet—\r\neven if I do not alight from above![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_06
text: But I digress. We are both artists, are we not?\nWe have no further use for words now.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_07
text: I assume you are ready? Let our collaborative\nwork of art begin![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_08
text: Seeing you in the midst of battle—you are like a\nunique gradient, subtly changing hues![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_09
text: Riotous and yet gentle! Such contrast... I lack the\nwords to express it. My hat goes off to you![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_10
text: My battles with you are truly a gift. Each time, I\nam made to remember how I felt so long ago\r\nwhen I first ventured into this world of art.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_11
text: Ah, I almost forgot. You were here for the Gym\ninspection in the Top Champion’s stead, correct?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_12
text: Well, that is of no consequence. Report on my\nGym here as you see fit.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_13
text: Ah! My inspiration is overflowing, as if drawn\nfrom a bottomless well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_020_kusa_14
text: I will begin on a new piece at once! You must\nexcuse me. Farewell![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
